name: 07029 · Harrison, NJ
findings: ZIP 07029 (Harrison) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07029 (Harrison) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07029 (Harrison) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 22% of the typical level).
